tools.name: ReadData
tools.signature: ReadData(question: str, input: str, role?: 'pre_post'|'hansen'|'ndvi_nbr'|'vh'|'wildfire'|'deforestation'|'urban_expansion'|'drought'|'air_pollution'|'hospitals_and_schools'|'highways'|'nearest_highway'|'population_in_footprint'|'schools'|'population'|'post_disaster'|'buildings'|'target_classes'|'scene_a'|'scene_b'|'roads_shelters_flood'|'roads_shelters_flood_rgb'|'primary'|'known_water_reference', time?: 'event'|'event_window'|'pre_post_epochs'|'2001_2023', options?: dict)
tools.description: Open a named input handle for the current question, validate its local artifact paths, and return a scene handle containing the discovered raster/vector/image/report refs. The evaluator must initialize the session first with code/scripts/initialize_tool_session.py; case contents are not agent-visible tool arguments.

args.question: Question handle, usually question_1.
args.input: Canonical input handle to open, such as hazard_stack_1 or sar_chip_1.
args.role: Optional call role; a specific artifact-card role is authoritative.
args.time: Optional temporal selector; a specific artifact-card time is authoritative.
args.options: Optional data-selection hints such as source groups or bands.

tools.name: PrepareScene
tools.signature: PrepareScene(question: str, inputs: dict, mode: 'forest'|'hazard'|'xbd_damage'|'sar_flood'|'routing'|'scene_compare'|'forest_change'|'forest_timeseries'|'forest_false_positive'|'baseline_canopy'|'forest_loss_history'|'forest_cross_modal'|'sar_change'|'wildfire_burn'|'forest_loss'|'built_up_gain'|'drought_anomaly'|'pollution_peak'|'multisource_hazard'|'wildfire_burn_exposure'|'forest_loss_exposure'|'built_up_gain_exposure'|'drought_anomaly_exposure'|'pollution_peak_exposure'|'xbd_grid'|'xbd_quadrants'|'xbd_scene_summary'|'flood_safe_routing'|'sar_flood_reference'|'sar_flood_diagnostic', checks?: dict)
tools.description: Build an aligned work context from one or more opened scene handles. It checks handle types and records the processing mode before downstream analytics.

args.question: Question handle.
args.inputs: Mapping from semantic slot names to scene handles, for example {'hazard':'scene_1'}.
args.mode: Supported preparation mode; task-specific names normalize to a guarded broad mode.
args.checks: Optional required checks, such as grid size or spatial alignment requirements.

tools.name: ComputeStats
tools.signature: ComputeStats(question: str, work: str, metrics: dict, region?: 'aoi'|'scene')
tools.description: Compute numeric statistics for a work/damage/hazard handle, including area, counts, means, z-scores, class histograms, or footprint summaries.

args.question: Question handle.
args.metrics: Broad metric family requested by the question. Prefer canopy_cover, forest_loss_history, sar_change, hazard_area, vegetation_anomaly, pollution_peak, or damage_summary.

tools.name: MeasureArea
tools.signature: MeasureArea(question: str, work: str, target: 'forest_loss', unit: 'hectares')
tools.description: Measure area for extracted objects or masks in the requested units by reading the underlying raster/vector data referenced by the input handle.

tools.name: CompareSources
tools.signature: CompareSources(question: str, work: str, compare: dict)
tools.description: Compare multiple modalities or source layers, such as optical-vs-SAR, multi-source hazard agreement, or predicted-flood overlap versus pixels outside a known-water reference. Known-water context does not by itself establish temporal novelty.

tools.name: DetectChange
tools.signature: DetectChange(question: str, work: str, change: 'largest_loss_year'|'dominant_clearing_interval', window?: '2001_2023'|'pre_post_epochs')
tools.description: Detect or localize temporal change windows or dominant change events from a work handle.

tools.name: ClassifyChange
tools.signature: ClassifyChange(question: str, work: str, labels: dict, rule: 'forest_loss'|'change_window'|'false_positive_type'|'canopy_density'|'concordance'|'cross_modal_concordance')
tools.description: Classify a change, canopy state, concordance state, or false-positive category using explicit labels/rules.

tools.name: ScoreHazard
tools.signature: ScoreHazard(question: str, work: str, hazard: 'forest_disturbance'|'wildfire'|'deforestation'|'urban_expansion'|'drought'|'air_pollution'|'building_damage', scale: 'vh_delta_severity'|'question_defined_class'|'benchmark_relative_column_quartile'|'impact_footprint'|'spatial_concentration')
tools.description: Score hazard class, severity, concentration, or impact footprint from a prepared/analytic handle.

tools.name: EstimateExposure
tools.signature: EstimateExposure(question: str, work: str, exposure: 'blocked_roads'|'high_no2_column_population'|'highway_representatives_within_5km'|'nearest_highway'|'population_in_footprint'|'schools', metrics: dict)
tools.description: Estimate exposure of people/assets/roads/facilities to a hazard footprint or blocked-road layer.

tools.name: AssessDamage
tools.signature: AssessDamage(question: str, work: str, aggregation: 'scene'|'grid_4x4'|'quadrant_2x2'|'severe_only'|'pair_compare', severity?: 'severe'|'major_or_destroyed')
tools.description: Aggregate building-damage polygons into scene, grid, quadrant, severe-only, or pair-comparison summaries.

args.question: Question handle.
args.severity: Optional severity filter, when required by the aggregation.

tools.name: RankRegions
tools.signature: RankRegions(question: str, work: str, by: 'severe_footprint_area_m2'|'severe_area_m2'|'severe_damage_count'|'severe_count'|'normalized_damage_severity'|'normalized_severity'|'severity_score'|'severity_score_normalized'|'flood_percentage'|'flood_pixels'|'flood_area', candidates: 'grid_4x4'|'quadrants_2x2', top_k?: int)
tools.description: Rank regions, components, grid cells, quadrants, or route candidates by the requested score.

args.question: Question handle.
args.top_k: Number of ranked entries to return.

tools.name: CompareScenes
tools.description: Compare two prepared scene summaries and decide which scene has the larger damage/risk signal.

tools.name: ExtractObjects
tools.signature: ExtractObjects(question: str, work: str, target: 'forest_loss_patches'|'severe_buildings'|'flood_polygons'|'flood_components', filters?: dict)
tools.description: Extract object sets such as forest-loss patches, severe buildings, flood polygons, or flood components. Sentinel flood polygons and components use 8-neighbour connectivity and produce validated run-scoped GeoJSON or label-raster artifacts.

tools.name: MapFlood
tools.description: Produce a run-scoped 0/1/255 candidate-flood mask from a prepared SAR scene. The published Sentinel contract supports the validated s1_min_backscatter_otsu_v1 method.

tools.name: DescribeFlood
tools.signature: DescribeFlood(question: str, work: str, metrics: dict)
tools.description: Select and summarize requested flood-mask/component/polygon metrics, including exact-grid areas, centroids, 4x4 grids, and known-water overlap statistics from the causal handle.

tools.name: PlanRoutes
tools.signature: PlanRoutes(question: str, work: str, objective: 'nearest_reachable_shelter'|'candidate_routes'|'overlay_routes', avoid: dict)
tools.description: Recompute route metrics and composite edge costs from declared packaged geometry/road products, then select eligible fastest, safest-weighted, and balanced candidates; this worker does not run a new graph search.

args.question: Question handle.
args.avoid: Required packaged eligibility assertion: flood_affected_roads must be true.

tools.name: CompareRoutes
tools.signature: CompareRoutes(question: str, work: str, prefer: dict)
tools.description: Compare requested validated fastest, safest-weighted, and balanced candidates and compute the full trade-off when all three are requested, without adding an evacuation recommendation.

args.question: Question handle.
args.prefer: Boolean fastest/safest/balanced groups to include; at least one must be true.

tools.name: RenderMap
tools.signature: RenderMap(question: str, work: str, layers: dict, style: 'route_overlay'|'flood_diagnostic')
tools.description: Render a fresh run-scoped map/image artifact and validation manifest from the current analytical handle and exactly the requested declared layers; prepared answer overlays and unrequested context layers are not retrieved.
